topic: No February-start qualifying event established in current bounded searches
description: Nine captured English/Mongolian searches, including full-month, Feb 1–7 and Feb 15–28 windows, local iKon and regional/sector terms, returned no verified February event with documented occurrence, own-state demand and ≥50 simultaneous participants. Search results mostly concerned Dec 2022 protests, later 2023 educator events or unrelated/out-of-period content. This is not proof of absence; a dedicated Feb 8–14 search and systematic local archive coverage remain gaps.

Search output did not expose result totals/native clocks and could return stale results despite month wording. No systematic local-language database or LexisNexis access; no event bodies opened for February because no in-scope source lead with unresolved decisive facts emerged.
